name: Kamai AI
description:
Kamai turns construction blueprints into structured data. Its geometric foundational models read your sheet sets and return areas, volumes, lengths, counts, and materials, each number keyed back to the sheet, layer, and geometry it came from, so every quantity is traceable.

Connect Kamai to create projects, ingest drawings from a URL or straight from a PDF you share in the conversation, and read structured takeoff data without leaving Claude. Projects, blueprints, takeoffs, and uploads render as interactive views in chat, so you can page through sheets and inspect quantities visually instead of reading raw output.

Use it for quantity takeoff, material estimating, bid preparation, scope checks, and drawing review. Available now for interior finishes (Div 09), plumbing (Div 22), and electrical (Div 26), with more divisions coming.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kamai AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kamai AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.kamai.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kamai AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kamai AI lists 13 MCP tools, including create_project, finalize_blueprint_upload, get_blueprint, get_project, list_projects, request_blueprint_upload, update_project, view_blueprint, view_projects, view_takeoff, ingest_blueprint_from_chat, and open_kamai.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kamai AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kamai AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Kamai AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kamai AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kamai AI is developed by Kamai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
